newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: Slovenia Radenska increases shares to be listed.
newsitem.headline: Slovenia Radenska increases shares to be listed.

text.p: Slovenian health resort operator and mineral water producer Radenska will list 4.1 million shares on the bourse rather than the 3.8 million reported earlier, the Ljubljana Stock Exchange said on Monday.
The number of shares was increased due to the addition of 303,711 shares that became tradeable at the end of January when Radenska completed privatisation, the bourse said.
Radenska will be listed on the main market of the bourse. The first day of trading has yet to be determined, but Radenska said it expected trading to start at the beginning of April.
The listed shares represent 81.2 percent of the firm's equity and have a nominal value of 1,000 tolars each.
Radenska stock currently trades around 1,600 tolars ($10.4) on the grey market.
Radenska joins a bunch of 32 newly privatised companies that have been listed on the stock exchange since January 1996.
At the moment there are 26 shares traded on the main market and 35 on the OTC market of the exchange. -- Marja Novak, Ljubljana newsroom, 386-61-125-8439
